purpose: Bind retained and bounded math-source evidence while separating natural worked material, filtered web math, refined/generated solutions and unavailable candidates.
evidence_boundary: This manifest records inventory and bounded diagnostics only. It does not establish mathematical correctness, source rights, contamination clearance, eligible supply or training authority.

common_contract.stage: pretraining math/support bank; refined/generated math remains a separate family
common_contract.transformation_type: natural worked material, filtered web math and generated/refined solutions are distinct identities
common_contract.source_family: Keep FineMath, UltraData-Math, InfiWebMath and generated teacher families separate until the joint graph is frozen.
common_contract.quality_vector: Record source score, extraction completeness, notation preservation, solution status, teacher/source provenance and independent-check outcome.
common_contract.dependency_metadata: Record prompt/solution/source links and derivation context; null is explicit when a bounded sample lacks lineage.
common_contract.contamination_status: open; exact GSM8K checks and bounded overlaps do not establish population-wide benchmark clearance.
common_contract.lineage: Bind dataset revision/configuration, original source or teacher, transformations and rejection reasons separately.
common_contract.unique_tokens: Report retained, sampled, rejected and eligible Mistral tokens separately; sample counts are not population yield.
common_contract.exposure_tokens: not set; no math source currently supports a production exposure claim.
common_contract.repetition_count: not set; repetition cannot fill a correctness or supply gap.

measured_preflight.decision: retain_source_and_directory_view_as_reversible_candidate; correctness and joint family gates remain open
retain_as_natural_math_candidate_only; resolve host lineage and independently check solutions before admission

out_of_matrix_review_candidates.boundary: Bounded schema, source-label and GSM8K exact-match diagnostics; independent correctness, full contamination, source-use and eligible supply remain open.
Keep refined/generated math separate until lineage, teacher/source provenance, independent correctness and finite supply are bound.
Keep the 3+ viewer sample separate from the pinned 4+ candidate and retained FineMath stock.

measured_diagnostics.interpretation: These are bounded inventory and triage measurements. They do not certify solution correctness or establish eligible population yield.

comparison_contract.contrast: Select one qualified natural/refined math intervention against an eligible shared baseline; filtered web and generated/refined sources remain separate factors.
not_allowed: combining source, teacher and schedule changes without a direct comparison
treating arithmetic agreement or boxed-answer agreement as independent correctness
using viewer samples as full-release supply
comparison_contract.study_slot: ladder families P1 (FineMath floor) and P4 (math repetition)

required_before_use: Joint source-family, host, benchmark and evaluation partition.
Independent solution correctness and completeness checks across representative domains and lengths.
Extraction/notation fidelity decision, including likely transcription-error handling.
Eligible Mistral token counts and preparation cost by source/quality/coverage stratum.
A predeclared ladder record before a math arm runs.
admission_boundary: This is a launch-blocked math candidate manifest. It does not admit any math source, authorize acquisition or change the compute budget.
